enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Keep eyes closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Look in mirror. Adjust shirt. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take out scrubs. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital ward. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Record data on chart. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Walk to nurses' station. Update patient records. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to patient room.

Walk to cafeteria. Wait in line. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Stand up. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk to break room. Sit on chair. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Record data. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Walk to nurses' station. Update patient records. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to patient room.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Open door. Enter apartment. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pot. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Add meat to pot. Stir ingredients. Add spices. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Keep eyes closed.
